pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Why Lumen makes candles the honest way — coconut-soy wax, cotton wicks, phthalate-free scent you can read on the label, and vessels designed to be washed out and refilled.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Lumen started with a simple, slightly annoyed question: why is it so hard to find out what’s actually in a candle? Most of them list one word — “fragrance” — and burn a black ring onto the ceiling. We wanted the opposite: a candle we could read the whole label of, that smelled clean and fresh and burned without leaving anything behind.

So everything is poured by hand in a coconut-soy blend, with lead-free cotton wicks and fragrance we blend phthalate- and paraben-free, then tested for weeks before a scent earns a place. We print the full ingredient list on every box, and we design each vessel to be washed out and refilled — because the cleanest candle is also the one you don’t throw away.
No mystery scent, no soot, no landfill of empty glass. Just bright, honest fragrance for ordinary days — and a refill waiting when it burns down.
